views.purpose: The cnc-runtime viewpoint is chosen because it explicitly exposes runtime components and connectors, directly answering questions about component involvement, communication, and execution flow for user registration.
required_evidence: runtime components involved in user registration
connectors and communication channels between components
execution flow and order of calls during registration
functional suitability evidence of the registration components
views.diagram_language_rule: viewpoint agent chose plantuml: PlantUML provides robust support for drawing runtime components, connectors, and sequence-based interactions to answer connectivity and control-flow questions.

notes: Eligible because they frame the chosen concerns: context, cnc-runtime

The context viewpoint was rejected because it focuses on system boundaries and external actors rather than the internal runtime components and connectors needed to answer detailed connectivity, control-flow, and functional suitability questions for integration testing.
